---
name: Bug report
about: A skill behaved wrongly in a real run
title: ''
labels: bug
---

**Agent and version**
e.g. Claude Code 2.x, or codex-cli 0.167.0 with gpt-5.4.

**Install route**
Plugin (`lochinbekdev-security@lochinbekdev`, which version?) or `scripts/link-skills.sh` symlinks.

**Skill and how it was invoked**
e.g. `/lochinbekdev-security:audit-api`, or "audit the uploads in this project".

**What happened**
What the agent produced or refused. Quote the shortest decisive part — no hostnames,
credentials or customer data.

**What you expected**
Which rule in `SKILL.md` or `docs/` was not followed.
